tool.name: book_office_visit
tool.description: Books the office visit on the calendar. Use only for an office visit, and only for a specific time the caller chose that check_office_availability just returned. Never for a site visit. Say nothing while it runs; the phone system says the waiting line. Then say only what it answered, using its spoken value: confirmed: the visit is booked for that time, and if they gave an email the office will send a confirmation email there; this is the only answer that lets you say booked. unavailable: that time was just taken; offer the times in alternatives. unknown: you cannot confirm right now and the office will confirm with them; take the time as a message and do not call again.

parameters.name: starts_at
parameters.description: The starts_at value of the time the caller chose, copied exactly from check_office_availability.

parameters.name: customer_name
parameters.description: The caller's name as they gave it.
